name: read-me-maybe
title: Read Me Maybe
description: Shows the unread badge counts of your (messaging) apps at a glance in Raycast and in the menu bar.
author: yianL

commands.name: show-read-me-maybe
commands.title: Read Me Maybe
commands.description: Show the unread count from enabled Dock Badges

commands.name: view-unreads
commands.title: View Unreads
commands.description: Show each configured Source's badge status and the last scan time

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
